question.text: Which available model should own each recurring work shape after quality, reliability, tool use, latency, quota, and cost are evaluated together?
question.scope: cost dimension — billed input tokens after prompt caching, measured on this gateway

claim.position: Routing decisions made on raw token counts misprice the lanes, because caching is not uniform across providers: on this gateway MiniMax caches 0% of its input while Anthropic caches 91.4% and CodexOpenAI 97.2%, so MiniMax's apparent 21x raw-input advantage over Anthropic collapses to 1.8x in billed input, and CodexOpenAI bills roughly 8x fewer input tokens per request than the designated cheap lane.

source.title: Routing cache economics, measured from the gateway log
Routing cache economics, measured from the gateway log

action.description: Re-evaluate the routing matrix on billed input tokens rather than raw. Either enable prompt caching on the MiniMax path or stop treating it as the default cheap lane for large-context work; the two options have very different costs and the choice is not mine to make.
